faq.q: What does 55+ mean for a home in Maple Ridge?
faq.a: Most 55+ strata communities in BC set an age rule in their bylaws, commonly that at least one resident is 55 or older, and many also limit children and rentals. The rules differ from one building to the next, so read the bylaws and the Form B Information Certificate before you make an offer on a unit in Maple Ridge.

faq.q: Can I rent out a 55+ unit in Maple Ridge?
faq.a: Whether a unit can be rented depends on the strata's current bylaws and the provincial rules that apply to them, and many 55+ buildings restrict rentals. Ask for the bylaws and the strata minutes before you buy a unit in Maple Ridge as an investment.

faq.q: How do I find out which school serves an address in Maple Ridge?
faq.a: School catchments are set by address, so use the school district's catchment locator with the exact address. Catchment lines change, so check before you write an offer.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.
